source_snapshot.effective_baseline: Tracked source content at the recorded Git tree IDs plus the exact working-tree bytes recorded below. No installed resource-pack overrides were available in the checked application-owned resource-pack directory.

size_methodology.source_file_bytes: Exact current working-tree file length in bytes; sha256 is computed over the same exact bytes. Tracked inputs only.
size_methodology.installed_size: The v2 installed resource tree does not yet exist. Each record therefore reports installed_size.bytes=null with a direct or generated output measurement method. No RCC-compressed or application-container size is inferred from source bytes.
size_methodology.decoded_or_resident_size: Unknown unless produced by the future runtime measurement method referenced on that record. Source file bytes are not used as decoded/resident estimates. Image, font, PDF, Office, stylesheet, translation, JSON, and QML methods are explicit in measurement_methods.

measurement_methods.installed_direct: Not measured: the Phase 4 v2 installed resource tree has not been built. Once available, stat each canonical installed file after the offline-bake/package step; report container or executable overhead separately. The source_file byte count is exact and is not a claim about a compressed RCC or future package size.
measurement_methods.installed_generated: Not measured: the build-generated runtime form has not been produced for the v2 package. Stat the generated .qm, compiled QML module, or other installed output in the staged package; keep its size separate from the exact tracked source_file bytes.
measurement_methods.installed_none: Not applicable: this input is excluded from the v2 runtime resource tree or is a build-only input. No installed resource file is expected from this source record.
measurement_methods.resident_json: Unknown until the selected JSON is decoded by the v2 implementation. Measure the owned decoded model/container capacity and its lifetime in the resource trace; source bytes are not a decoded-memory estimate.
measurement_methods.resident_image: Unknown until the real decoder and target size are selected. Load with the production Qt image path and record QImage::sizeInBytes() (or the equivalent QPixmap backing allocation) at the actual device pixel ratio and requested size. Do not sum these values as concurrent residency unless the resources are simultaneously retained.
measurement_methods.resident_vector_image: Unknown until the actual SVG target dimensions and device pixel ratio are known. Render through the production Qt SVG/icon path and record the resulting raster allocation; vector source bytes are not decoded resident bytes.
measurement_methods.resident_font: Unknown: source font bytes do not represent native font residency. Measure process resident-memory change around registration/removal for the specific face on each supported platform, and record the loaded family and registration lifetime.
measurement_methods.resident_pdf: Unknown and content-dependent. Measure the active QPdfDocument load and page-render path with the intended file-backed input; record the rendered page QImage::sizeInBytes(), active document count, and process working-set/RSS deltas. Close/replacement measurements must show release. No PDF body is counted as startup residency.
measurement_methods.resident_office: Unknown and consumer-dependent. Measure the actual Office import, export, or external-process path for a requested file, including temporary buffers and process working-set deltas. Do not infer a decoded size from ZIP/archive source bytes.
measurement_methods.resident_stylesheet: Unknown until the theme loader is implemented. Measure the decoded stylesheet string and retained style object after loading one active theme; measure release or replacement when the theme changes.
measurement_methods.resident_translation: Unknown until the selected generated .qm is loaded. Measure the QTranslator load and process resident-memory delta for one locale; verify that replacing a locale releases the prior translator.
measurement_methods.resident_qml: Unknown until the compiled QML module and Calendar object tree are measured. Record the installed module bytes separately from the Calendar page's object and image residency, then measure page release.
measurement_methods.resident_build_only: Not applicable to the v2 runtime loader: this record is a build input or is excluded. If its generated output is installed, measure that output under its own runtime resource record.
measurement_methods.stream_file_document: Candidate: open a requested installed file through a file-backed QIODevice/consumer interface, without first copying the full body to a catalog buffer. Confirm the chosen adapter's actual read and cache behavior in its implementation and resource trace.
measurement_methods.stream_consumer_dependent: Consumer-dependent: pass the requested file path or file-backed device to the owning Office/import/export adapter. Confirm whether that adapter streams or materializes the complete document before assigning a final streamability guarantee.
measurement_methods.stream_no: No streaming contract is planned for this small metadata, style, font, icon, or image resource. Load/decode only at the owning tier and retain it only for its declared lifetime.
measurement_methods.stream_build_only: Not applicable to a runtime resource: this is a build-time source input or an excluded file.
